smokestack.blueprint.creative_only: The Plant Blueprint only works in creative mode
smokestack.blueprint.locked: Plot set: %s x %s blocks, %s high. Right-click the same block again to build
smokestack.blueprint.hud.aim: Plot %s x %s, %s high | Right-click: set gate | Sneak + right-click: change size
smokestack.blueprint.hud.locked: Plot %s x %s, %s high | Right-click the same block to build
smokestack.blueprint.tooltip.use1: Right-click a block: mark the gate, then again to build
smokestack.build.done: Plant finished (%s x %s). Boilers are stocked with coal
smokestack.ponder.coal_boiler.text_1: Coal Boilers burn solid fuel to turn water into steam
smokestack.ponder.coal_boiler.text_2: Fuel enters from hoppers, funnels or by right-clicking with coal
smokestack.ponder.coal_boiler.text_3: Water comes from pipes, or from a water source block touching the boiler
smokestack.ponder.coal_boiler.text_4: Steam pressure builds slowly while the fire is lit
smokestack.ponder.chimney_draft.text_1: Without a chimney the fire is starved and the turbine only reaches about 60 RPM
smokestack.ponder.chimney_draft.text_2: Every Flue Segment stacked directly above the boiler improves the draft
smokestack.ponder.chimney_draft.text_3: 24 segments give full pressure and 128 RPM, but the boiler then burns coal much faster
smokestack.ponder.steam_turbine.text_1: Place a Steam Turbine against a boiler. The shaft comes out of the opposite side
smokestack.ponder.steam_turbine.text_3: At full pressure one turbine matches a Creative Motor: 128 RPM and 16384 su
smokestack.ponder.plant_blueprint.text_1: The Plant Blueprint is creative only. Right-click where the gate should be
smokestack.ponder.plant_blueprint.text_2: A box shows the footprint, for example 100 x 70 blocks
smokestack.ponder.plant_blueprint.text_3: Sneak and right-click to switch between 64 x 48, 100 x 70 and 140 x 100
smokestack.ponder.plant_blueprint.text_4: Right-click the same block again and the plant builds itself, ground first
